# discord_auto_moderation_rule (Resource)

Manages a Discord auto moderation rule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_type` (Number) The event type (1 = MESSAGE_SEND).
- `name` (String) The name of the rule.
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID.
- `trigger_type` (Number) The trigger type (1 = KEYWORD, 3 = SPAM, 4 = KEYWORD_PRESET, 5 = MENTION_SPAM).

### Optional

- `actions` (Block List) Actions to execute when the rule is triggered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--actions))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `exempt_channels` (List of String) Channel IDs exempt from this rule (max 50).
- `exempt_roles` (List of String) Role IDs exempt from this rule (max 20).
- `trigger_metadata` (Attributes) The trigger metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger_metadata))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the auto moderation rule.

<a id="nestedblock--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `type` (Number) The action type (1 = BLOCK_MESSAGE, 2 = SEND_ALERT_MESSAGE, 3 = TIMEOUT).

Optional:

- `metadata` (Attributes) Additional metadata for the action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--metadata))

<a id="nestedatt--actions--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.metadata`

Optional:

- `channel_id` (String) Channel to send alert messages to (for type 2).
- `custom_message` (String) Custom message shown to the user when blocked (for type 1, max 150 chars).
- `duration_seconds` (Number) Timeout duration in seconds (for type 3, max 2419200).



<a id="nestedatt--trigger_metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger_metadata`

Optional:

- `allow_list` (List of String) Substrings which should not trigger the rule.
- `keyword_filter` (List of String) Keywords to filter (max 1000, each max 60 chars).
- `mention_raid_protection_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to automatically detect mention raids (trigger type 5).
- `mention_total_limit` (Number) Total unique role and user mentions allowed per message (trigger type 5, max 50).
- `presets` (List of Number) Preset keyword lists (1 = PROFANITY, 2 = SEXUAL_CONTENT, 3 = SLURS).
- `regex_patterns` (List of String) Regex patterns to match (max 10, each max 260 chars).
